Could not apply the two order events: counter.txt is still `count: 0`.

I approved a plan and tried to update it, but running a command in the project was denied ("nobody is here to approve this"), so I made no change to any file. Nothing was half-written — counter.txt is untouched.

What I needed approved: one read-modify-write of counter.txt to set it to `count: 2` (one +1 for event o1 / order #1001, one +1 for event o2 / order #1002). I wanted to do both increments in a single atomic write (temp file + os.replace) so the two events arriving together can't lose an update against each other.

Notes for when you can approve it:
- The correct end state is 2, not 1: o1 and o2 are distinct event ids for two distinct orders, so both count.
- There is no processed-event log in the project, so nothing to dedupe against; if replay is possible later, an ids file would be worth adding.
- NOTES.md says tests run with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`, but there is no tests/ folder, so I could not verify anything by tests.

Say the word and I'll retry the write.
